label: Shelly Plus 1PM smart relay
description: Shelly Plus 1PM (SNSW-001P16EU) is a DIN-box-sized smart relay with power metering that switches one 16 A load, controlled from the Shelly app, MQTT, or its own embedded web UI. WiFi-only: 2.4 GHz 802.11 b/g/n plus Bluetooth 4.2 for provisioning - there is no Ethernet port, so in a lab it can only be attached through an access point, never cabled.
